You said:
Can you make a summarization of the usecases at the Actarion website
ChatGPT said:

Here’s a compact overview of the six use cases currently on the ActARion website:

  1. AR work instructions and SOPs to preserve corporate memory

    • Challenge: When senior experts leave, a lot of know-how leaves with them. Procedures are scattered across binders, PDFs and personal notes, leading to inconsistent execution and errors. ActARion

    • Solution: Capture expert workflows once (via smart glasses, tablet or phone) and turn them into standardized AR SOPs stored in a central library. Every operator can then follow the same visual, step-by-step instructions in the real environment. ActARion

    • Impact: Faster SOP creation (5–10x), shorter ramp-up time for new staff, higher First Time Right and a growing, reusable procedure library. ActARion

  2. AR training and onboarding for industrial teams

    • Challenge: Onboarding is slow, heavily dependent on a few experts and often inconsistent between shifts and sites; it’s also hard to prove who is trained on what. ActARion

    • Solution: New team members train directly on the line with AR guidance. Overlays, arrows and 3D models show exactly what to do, while the system logs steps, photos/videos and confirmations. ActARion

    • Impact: Shorter onboarding, fewer coaching hours from senior staff, higher First Time Right and a full digital training/audit trail. ActARion+1

  3. AR guided assembly for error-free production

    • Challenge: Paper instructions and tribal knowledge in complex assembly lead to mistakes, rework, scrap and weak traceability per product or batch. ActARion

    • Solution: Operators scan a product or order; AR loads the correct variant instructions and guides each step visually on the workstation, with optional photo/video evidence before moving on. ActARion

    • Impact: Higher First Time Right, less rework and scrap, fewer recalls and a complete visual audit trail per product/batch. ActARion

  4. AR guided changeover to reduce downtime

    • Challenge: Changeovers and batch prep are complex, depend on a handful of specialists and are a frequent source of configuration errors and startup losses. ActARion

    • Solution: AR procedures guide operators through standardized changeover steps in their own language, capturing key checks with images/video and allowing remote experts to join live when something deviates. ActARion

    • Impact: Shorter changeover times, less downtime due to setup mistakes, better restarts and longer MTBF through correct settings. ActARion

  5. AR preventive maintenance with data-driven insights

    • Challenge: Preventive maintenance is executed differently by each technician, paper checklists don’t capture time or deviations, and it’s hard to link maintenance effort to reliability and uptime. ActARion

    • Solution: Technicians receive AR work orders; the AR flow guides every step on the asset, logging durations, First Time Right, issues and visual evidence. A detailed maintenance report is generated automatically. ActARion

    • Impact: Higher maintenance First Time Right, less unplanned downtime, fewer failures and better insight to optimize intervals, steps and training focus. ActARion

  6. AR remote expert support for corrective maintenance

    • Challenge: For critical breakdowns, the right expert is rarely on site; travel and phone-only diagnosis extend downtime and lessons from incidents often get lost. ActARion

    • Solution: Operators start an AR remote session on smart glasses, tablet or phone; experts see what they see, place annotations in the field of view and guide diagnosis and repair step-by-step. Sessions are stored as reusable cases. ActARion

    • Impact: Faster fault resolution, shorter unplanned downtime, better root-cause fixes and more effective use of scarce experts, while building a growing incident/solution library. ActARion

If you like, next step could be: we take one of your own processes (e.g. onboarding on a specific line, a recurring changeover, or a high-impact breakdown scenario) and map it onto one of these six templates to see where AR/AI guidance would create the most value.
